title: Take Care Of
subtitle: 「照顧／處理／負責／維護」，究竟是哪一種 take care of？
description: 「照顧／處理／負責／維護」，究竟是哪一種 take care of？

words.note: 最直接、最常見的近義說法之一，表示照顧人、動物或物件，確保其安全、健康或正常狀態；英式英語尤其常用。
words.example: She looks after her elderly father at weekends.
words.exampleZh: 她逢週末照顧年邁的父親。

exercises.original: Can you take care of the children while I go to the appointment?
exercises.zh: 我去赴約時，你可以照顧孩子嗎？

options.explanation: handle = 較適合任務或問題，不如 look after 表達兒童照顧。
fix = 孩子不是要修理的物件。
look after = 短時間代為照顧兒童，是 look after 的典型語境。
deal with = 會有『應付孩子』的語感，不適合一般照顧。
maintain = 不形容照顧兒童。
protect = 只強調安全，未涵蓋完整照顧。

exercises.original: She takes care of her grandmother every weekend.
exercises.zh: 她每個週末都照顧祖母。

options.explanation: manage = 可管理事務，但不自然概括人際照顧。
handle = 語氣太任務化。
watch = 只表示留意，責任含義不足。
look after = 持續照顧家人最自然可用 look after。
maintain = 不合。
fix = 不合。

exercises.original: Who will take care of the dog while you're away?
exercises.zh: 你不在時，誰會照顧狗？

options.explanation: deal with = 容易暗示狗是問題。
handle = 較像操作或應付。
maintain = 不合動物。
fix = 不合。
look after = 外出期間代為餵食、照看動物，look after 最自然。
attend a meeting = 完全不合。

words.note: 當 take care of 強調對人、病人、長者、兒童或動物提供持續照護時很自然；語氣比 look after 稍正式，也常見於醫療和社福語境。
words.example: The nurses care for patients recovering from surgery.
words.exampleZh: 護士照顧手術後康復中的病人。

exercises.original: The centre takes care of older people who need daily support.
exercises.zh: 這個中心照顧需要日常支援的長者。

options.explanation: handles = 把人當工作項目處理，語感不恰當。
fixes = 不合。
maintains = 不合人際照護。
care for = 長者持續照護語境中，care for 特別自然。
deals with = 可能有負面『應付』語感。
watches = 只留意不足以表示 daily support。

exercises.original: Nurses take care of patients after major surgery.
exercises.zh: 護士照顧大型手術後的病人。

options.explanation: manage = 可以管理 ward，但不是直接護理病人的最佳替換。
handle = 不如 care for 有照護意味。
protect = 只涵蓋安全。
watch = 不足以表達護理。
care for = 醫療人員對病人提供照護，標準用語是 care for。
maintain = 不合。

exercises.original: The shelter takes care of injured animals until they recover.
exercises.zh: 收容所照顧受傷動物直到牠們康復。

options.explanation: fixes = 動物受傷不能說 fix animals。
deals with = 太像處理問題。
manages = 不夠有人道照護意味。
protects only = 只保護不足以涵蓋治療、餵養等。
watches = 不足以表達完整照護。
care for = injured animals + recovery 明確是持續照護，care for 最精確。

words.note: 常指細心照料植物、動物、傷口或有需要的人；比一般 take care of 更有『持續照料、處理需要』的意味。
words.example: He tends to the garden every morning.
words.exampleZh: 他每天早上都照料花園。

exercises.original: He takes care of the vegetable garden before work.
exercises.zh: 他上班前會照料菜園。

options.explanation: handles = 不自然描述園藝照料。
deals with = 會像花園是問題。
protects = 只保護不等於澆水、修剪等照料。
watches = 只是觀看。
tend to = 定期照料植物和花園，tend to 是典型搭配。
fixes = 不合。

exercises.original: The nurse took care of the wound before applying a fresh bandage.
exercises.zh: 護士在換上新繃帶前處理傷口。

options.explanation: managed = 可管理病情，但單個 wound 的實際護理更自然用 tend to。
watched = 只是觀察。
protected = 沒有表達清潔／護理。
fixed = 傷口不是機械故障。
maintained = 不合。
tend to = 醫療上照料傷口，tend to the wound 很自然。

exercises.original: She takes care of the horses every morning.
exercises.zh: 她每天早上照料馬匹。

options.explanation: tend to = 對動物進行日常餵養與照料，可用 tend to。
handles = 可能指駕馭／操作動物，但未必包括日常照料。
deals with = 語感偏應付。
fixes = 不合。
maintains = 較少直接用於動物。
observes = 只觀察，不表示餵養照料。

words.note: 較正式，表示立即或有系統地處理某項需要、問題、顧客、病人或任務；重點是給予所需注意。
words.example: A technician will attend to the problem this afternoon.
words.exampleZh: 技術員今天下午會處理這個問題。

exercises.original: A member of staff will take care of your request shortly.
exercises.zh: 職員稍後會處理你的要求。
exercises.upgrade: attend to · 處理；照料；照應

options.explanation: look after = request 不是人或動物。
watch over = 不合抽象請求。
maintain = 不合。
protect = 不合。
fix = request 不是故障。
attend to = 較正式地表示職員會處理顧客要求，attend to 很自然。

exercises.original: The doctor was called to take care of an urgent patient.
exercises.zh: 醫生被召來處理一名緊急病人的需要。
exercises.upgrade: attend to · 處理；照料；照應

options.explanation: attend to = 醫護人員立即處理病人的需要，attend to 是標準搭配。
manage = 過於行政。
handle = 可理解，但醫療語境 attend to a patient 更自然。
protect = 只表示保護。
maintain = 不合。
watch = 不足以表示治療。

exercises.original: Please take care of the customer at the front desk.
exercises.zh: 請處理前台這位顧客的需要。
exercises.upgrade: attend to · 處理；照料；照應

options.explanation: fix = 不合。
attend to = 服務人員給予顧客所需注意，attend to 很自然。
maintain = 不合。
protect = 不合一般服務。
watch = 不夠。
deal with = 可用，但有時較像處理麻煩，服務語境 attend to 更禮貌。

words.note: 較口語，表示負責把某件事處理好、安排妥當或確保完成；不一定涉及照顧人。
words.example: I'll see to the travel arrangements before Friday.
words.exampleZh: 我會在星期五前把旅行安排辦妥。

exercises.original: I'll take care of the booking this afternoon.
exercises.zh: 我今天下午會把預訂辦妥。
exercises.upgrade: see to · 處理；確保辦妥

options.explanation: see to = 答應把一件安排辦妥，口語最自然可用 see to。
look after = booking 不是需照顧的人或物。
watch over = 不合。
protect = 不合。
maintain = 不合。
tend to = 雖可表示處理，但 booking 更自然用 see to。

exercises.original: Don't worry about the invitations; I'll take care of them.
exercises.zh: 別擔心邀請函，我會處理好。
exercises.upgrade: see to · 處理；確保辦妥

options.explanation: care for = 通常不照顧 invitations。
see to = Don't worry ... I'll ... 是典型『我會辦妥』語境，see to 很自然。
watch = 不合。
protect = 不合。
maintain = 不合。
fix = 沒有故障線索。

exercises.original: Someone needs to take care of the catering arrangements.
exercises.zh: 需要有人把餐飲安排處理妥當。
exercises.upgrade: see to · 處理；確保辦妥

options.explanation: watch over = 不是安全監護。
care for = 不合 arrangements。
see to = 安排和行政事項需要被辦妥時，see to 很貼切。
maintain = 不合。
protect = 不合。
fix = 沒有壞掉的東西。

words.note: 當 take care of 表示負責處理工作、問題、請求、投訴或情況時常用；比照顧義更偏任務管理。
words.example: The support team handles customer complaints.
words.exampleZh: 支援團隊負責處理顧客投訴。

exercises.original: The service desk takes care of complaints from customers.
exercises.zh: 服務櫃檯負責處理顧客投訴。

options.explanation: cares for = complaints 不是照護對象。
handle = complaints 是典型 handle 的工作任務。
watches over = 不合。
protects = 不合。
maintains = 不合。
tends to = 可表示處理，但商務投訴更自然用 handle。

exercises.original: I'll take care of the paperwork while you speak to the client.
exercises.zh: 你跟客戶談時，我來處理文件工作。

options.explanation: look after = 對 paperwork 不如 handle 自然。
care for = 不合。
handle = 負責完成一批行政工作，handle the paperwork 很自然。
protect = 不合。
watch = 不合。
maintain = 不是保養文件。

exercises.original: The team takes care of all technical enquiries.
exercises.zh: 團隊負責處理所有技術查詢。

options.explanation: watch over = 不合。
care for = 不合 enquiries。
maintain = 不是維護 enquiry。
handle = 作為部門職責處理 enquiries，handle 最精確。
protect = 不合。
fix = 不是所有 enquiry 都是故障。

words.note: 表示面對並處理問題、情況、請求或責任；語氣中性、適用範圍很廣。
words.example: We need to deal with the leak before it causes more damage.
words.exampleZh: 我們需要先處理漏水問題，以免造成更多損害。

exercises.original: We need to take care of this problem before it gets worse.
exercises.zh: 我們需要在問題惡化前處理它。

options.explanation: look after = problem 不是照顧對象。
care for = 不合。
deal with = 面對並處理一個 problem，deal with 是最常見搭配之一。
watch over = 不合。
maintain = 會有維持問題的錯誤語感。
protect = 不合。

exercises.original: The manager took care of the conflict between the two teams.
exercises.zh: 經理處理了兩個團隊之間的衝突。

options.explanation: maintained = 不能『維護衝突』。
looked after = 不自然。
protected = 不合。
deal with = 衝突屬需要應對和解決的情況，最自然用 deal with。
watched = 只是觀察，未處理。
cared for = 不合。

exercises.original: How should we take care of unexpected delays?
exercises.zh: 我們應如何應對突如其來的延誤？

options.explanation: watch over = 不合。
care for = 不合。
maintain = 不合。
protect = 不合。
deal with = 對不利情況作出應對，deal with 最精確。
fix = 延誤不一定能直接修理，只能管理／應對。

words.note: 當 take care of 指持續管理一項工作、資源、帳戶、項目或責任時適用；比 handle 更有持續管理意味。
words.example: She manages the bookings for the whole department.
words.exampleZh: 她負責管理整個部門的預約。

exercises.original: She takes care of the department's bookings and schedules.
exercises.zh: 她負責管理部門的預約和時間表。

options.explanation: cares for = 不合行政事項。
watches over = 太偏監護。
protects = 不合。
manage = 持續負責 bookings / schedules，manage 比一次性 handle 更精確。
fixes = 不合。
tends to = 可以處理，但長期管理系統更自然用 manage。

exercises.original: He takes care of several client accounts.
exercises.zh: 他負責管理數個客戶帳戶。

options.explanation: looks after = 口語可用，但商業職責最自然是 manage。
fixes = 帳戶不是故障。
protects = 只是管理的一部分。
watches = 不合。
manage = 長期負責多個 accounts 是典型 manage 語境。
attends to once = 會變成一次性處理，不如持續管理。

exercises.original: The facilities team takes care of the building's daily operations.
exercises.zh: 設施團隊負責管理大樓的日常運作。

options.explanation: watches over = 只看守不足以涵蓋日常運作。
cares for = 不合 operations。
fixes = 只涵蓋故障修理。
protects = 只涵蓋安全。
attends to = 較像逐項處理，不如 manage 表示持續管理。
manage = daily operations 是長期管理責任，最自然用 manage。

words.note: 當 take care of 的重點是某人正式承擔某項任務、人物或結果的責任時可用；比一般 handle 更突出責任歸屬。
words.example: He agreed to take responsibility for the budget.

exercises.original: Maria will take care of the budget for the new project.
exercises.zh: Maria 會負責新項目的預算。
exercises.upgrade: take responsibility for · 負責；承擔責任

options.explanation: look after = 較口語，且對預算責任不夠正式。
care for = 不合財務責任。
watch over = 不合。
fix = 不合。
take responsibility for = 當重點是正式指定誰負責 budget，take responsibility for 最精確。
tend to = 不如 responsibility 清楚表達責任歸屬。

exercises.original: Who is going to take care of the final report?
exercises.zh: 誰會負責最終報告？
exercises.upgrade: take responsibility for · 負責；承擔責任

options.explanation: watch = 不是單純看著報告。
care for = 不合。
maintain = 不是維護文件。
protect = 不合。
fix = 沒有錯誤修復線索。
take responsibility for = 如果問題是在分配正式責任，最清楚可說 take responsibility for。

exercises.original: The senior engineer agreed to take care of safety checks.
exercises.zh: 高級工程師同意負責安全檢查。
exercises.upgrade: take responsibility for · 負責；承擔責任

options.explanation: take responsibility for = agreed to + 重要職責顯示責任正式歸屬，take responsibility for 很自然。
look after = 可口語使用，但正式責任安排不如此精確。
care for = 不合。
watch over = 只監察不足以表示負責執行。
maintain = 不合 checks。
fix = 不合。

words.note: 表示照看某人或某物，尤其是為了安全、保護或監護；比 look after 更突出看守和保護。
words.example: A neighbour watched over the children until their parents returned.
words.exampleZh: 鄰居在孩子父母回來前代為看護他們。

exercises.original: A teacher stayed behind to take care of the children until their parents arrived.
exercises.zh: 一名老師留下來看護孩子，直到家長到達。

options.explanation: handle = 太像工作項目。
maintain = 不合。
fix = 不合。
deal with = 容易有『應付孩子』的語感。
manage = 若只暫時看護，不如 watch over 自然。
watch over = 短時間監護、確保安全，watch over 最精確。

exercises.original: The guard takes care of the entrance at night.
exercises.zh: 保安夜間負責看守入口。

options.explanation: watch over = 保安的主要功能是看守和保護，watch over 很自然。
cares for = 不合入口。
fixes = 沒有維修線索。
handles = 可負責入口事務，但 guard 語境更偏 watch over。
tends to = 不自然。
maintains = 除非做保養，否則不合。

exercises.original: Neighbours took care of the house while the owners were away.
exercises.zh: 屋主外出期間，鄰居幫忙看顧房子。

options.explanation: managed = 除非負責整套物業管理。
watch over = 屋主不在時代為看顧物業安全，watch over 最精確。
maintained = 若只看顧安全，maintenance 太具體。
fixed = 沒有故障。
dealt with = 不合。
attended to = 可處理需要，但不如 watch over 表達看守。

words.note: 當 take care of 指照料設備、建築、花園或系統，使其保持良好狀態時適用；不適合一般人際照顧語境。
words.example: The facilities team maintains the heating system throughout the year.
words.exampleZh: 設施團隊全年維護暖氣系統。

exercises.original: The company takes care of the equipment to keep it in good condition.
exercises.zh: 公司保養設備，使其保持良好狀態。

options.explanation: maintain = keep it in good condition 是 maintenance 的直接定義。
cares for = 不自然形容設備保養。
watches over = 只是監看，不等於保養。
deals with = 太泛，沒有維護意味。
handles = 表示處理，不一定保養。
protects = 只防止損壞，不含檢修保養。

exercises.original: A contractor takes care of the building's heating system.
exercises.zh: 承辦商負責維護大樓的暖氣系統。

options.explanation: looks after = 口語可用，但技術系統正式用 maintain 更精確。
maintain = 設備系統需要持續保養，最自然用 maintains。
watches = 不夠。
protects = 不包括檢查和保養。
handles = 太泛。
cares for = 不自然。

exercises.original: The grounds team takes care of the paths and fences throughout the year.
exercises.zh: 場地團隊全年維護小徑和圍欄。

options.explanation: watches over = 只是看守。
deals with = 不如 maintain 表達持續保養。
maintain = throughout the year + physical infrastructure 指長期 upkeep，maintain 最精確。
cares for = 較適合人、動物或植物。
handles = 太泛。
fixes = 只表示壞了才修，未涵蓋持續維護。

falseSynonyms.zh: 保護不等於完整照顧 protect 只強調避免傷害；take care of 還可包括餵食、安排、處理、維護等更廣責任。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Protecting someone is one part of caring for them, but not the whole task.

falseSynonyms.zh: 幫助不一定等於負責照顧 help 可以只是一次協助；take care of 往往表示較完整或持續的責任。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can help with a task without taking care of the whole task.

falseSynonyms.zh: 看著不等於照顧 watch 只表示觀看或留意；look after / watch over 才更清楚表示監護責任。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Watching a child is not always the same as being responsible for their care.

falseSynonyms.zh: 修理只適合部分問題 fix 指修復故障；take care of a problem 可以是安排、處理或解決，不一定涉及修理。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A technician may fix a machine, while a manager may simply take care of the issue.

falseSynonyms.zh: look after 只適合部分 take care of 語境 look after 很適合人、動物或物品照顧；但 take care of a complaint 更自然改成 handle / deal with。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You look after a child, but you handle a complaint.

falseSynonyms.zh: care for 也可表示喜歡 care for 可表示照顧，也可在某些結構中表示喜歡；需依上下文判斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She cares for her mother means she looks after her; she doesn't care for coffee means she doesn't like it.

falseSynonyms.zh: attend 和 attend to 不同 attend 常表示出席；attend to 才表示照料或處理。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You attend a meeting, but you attend to a patient's needs.

falseSynonyms.zh: 片語結構不同 take care 常表示小心、保重；take care of 才表示照顧或處理某人某事。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Take care on the stairs. Take care of the children.
